title: Make Auto evaluator expiry tests independent of host monotonic uptime
outcome: Expiry and duplicate-window tests demonstrate the same behavior without relying on subtracting five minutes from a platform Instant close to its representable origin.
acceptance: Verify the supported-platform Instant subtraction concern, then construct the expired observation deterministically without a possible representational underflow or real-time wait.

Existing expiry and duplicate-refusal behavioral assertions still discriminate fresh versus expired windows on the real selection path; no product timeout inflation or weakened assertion is introduced.
